findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler which has abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the new build_occurrence_and_event_data, but the class body is just pass. Instantiating it via Detector.detector_handler (group_type.detector_handler(self)) will raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class. Any detector with type metric_alert_fire is therefore broken.

findings.title: Duplicate group keys silently overwritten without logging
findings.body: process_detectors previously detected duplicate group_key results and logged Duplicate detector state group keys found. After changing evaluate to return dict keyed by group_key, evaluate does results[result.group_key] = result and process_detectors just iterates values. Conflicting results for the same key now last-wins with no log or metric, losing observability of a detector bug that the old code explicitly called out as shouldn't happen.

findings.title: get_state_data KeyErrors when counter_names is empty
findings.body: get_state_data initializes counter_updates to {} and only populates it inside if self.counter_names:. It then unconditionally does counter_updates[gk] when building DetectorStateData. A stateful detector that returns [] for counter_names will raise KeyError for every group key instead of returning empty/default counters.

findings.title: Mock occurrence helper ignores value and uses fixed IDs
findings.body: build_mock_occurrence_and_event takes value but never uses it and always returns the same IssueOccurrence id and event_id. test_state_results_multi_group sends group_2 value 10 but builds the expected occurrence with value 6 and still passes, and two different groups get identical IDs. Tests therefore cannot verify value propagation or ID/fingerprint uniqueness required by the new build_occurrence_and_event_data hook.
